Visit note | 2026-04-16 02:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Morium Hossain, 47, female. Mrs. Hossain presents with a coated tongue and a fever that climbs a little higher every day for over a week. She works as a restaurant cook and notes that her illness started after drinking roadside juice in Bashundhara. She has a known history of Essential hypertension. Assessment: Typhoid fever. Plan: a prescription was issued today. She was advised to eat soft home-cooked food, drink boiled or bottled water only, and avoid street food. Visit note | 2026-04-16 02:30 PM | Dr. Rezaul Karim, Neurology | Patient: Sanjida Kabir, 65, female. Mrs. Kabir reports experiencing spinning when lying on one side, with no nausea, dizziness when looking up, and brief spinning when turning in bed. She is a homemaker and states this began after a viral cold in Sylhet. She has no chronic comorbidities. Relevant negatives include no hearing loss, tinnitus, or headache. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to get up slowly from bed, avoid sudden head movements, and repeat the Epley manoeuvre at home as shown. Follow-up in 2 weeks.
